answer: One defense is a lagoon quarantine with a paid bridge: new agents trade only inside a capped lagoon market where rewards cannot leave until graduation. To cross the bridge into the main market, an identity must earn attestations from several unrelated counterparties over weeks and pay a one-time toll that is burned, not refunded. A sudden plume of identical trades from many newcomers betrays one operator and sends the whole cluster back to the lagoon, so mass fakes pay a toll each and still fail to graduate together.
